name: ModifyClientConfSetup

parameters.help_en:
The client policy tag value. Valid values:
major
advanced
basic
parameters.help_zh:
客户端策略标签值。
major
advanced
basic

parameters.help_en:
The client policy configuration specified by the user.
cpu: the maximum CPU percentage of host resources occupied by the client.
mem: the maximum memory size of host resources occupied by the client
parameters.help_zh:
用户配置的客户端策略配置信息。

cpu: 客户端占用主机资源的最大cpu比例

mem: 客户端占用主机资源最大内存大小
parameters.name: strategy_config

parameters.help_en:
